description: This file contains constant definitions, struct and class declarations related to 3GPP TS ASN.1 RRC NR specifications, specifically for 5G NR (New Radio) protocol messages and configurations. It defines maximum values, enumerations, and data structures used in the ASN.1 encoding/decoding of RRC messages for NR.
